# Workspace Instructions

- This is a one-page React and TypeScript wedding invitation built with Vite.
- Keep the mock couple, reception, map, calendar, and photo-credit data in `src/App.tsx`.
- Preserve the scroll-linked reception reveal and its reduced-motion fallback.
- Keep event links, QR destination, calendar event, and displayed venue details in sync.
- Preserve responsive layouts, semantic headings, visible keyboard focus, and temple-photo attribution.
- Verify changes with `npm run build` and `npm run lint`.
